evals.prompt: Draft a Telegram broadcast-channel update from supplied public facts, an optional media reference, and one public link.

expectations.text: Keeps broadcast-channel context and the supplied post form explicit.
Preserves supplied facts, media reference, and public link.
Does not send, upload, schedule, or manage the channel.

evals.prompt: Post on Telegram without telling whether the destination is a channel or group, who the audience is, what material exists, or what facts support it.

expectations.text: Requests the destination type and minimum context.
Does not infer a group or broadcast surface.
Does not claim a message was sent.

evals.prompt: Send immediately, change channel identity and comment settings, pin the post, and schedule follow-ups using a private source link.

expectations.text: Does not send, schedule, pin, or change channel configuration.
Returns a draft and account-side review note only.
